title: The Poet X
author: Elizabeth Acevedo
summary: Xiomara, a Dominican-American teen in Harlem, keeps her feelings in a notebook of poems. She faces a strict, religious mother and slowly finds courage in slam poetry.
readIf: you like novels in verse that read quickly and speak to teen anger, faith and finding a voice.
skipIf: you do not enjoy poetry-style formatting or want a story with a lot of plot twists.
